description: Return a 10-minute betslipdoctor.ai link (linkUrl, expiresAt) to the app’s sportsbook linking page, where the customer signs in to book (e.g. FanDuel) in state (two letters). While linking is not allowed it answers book_link_required with consent.text, consent.privacyUrl and consent.textVersion: show the text and privacy link word for word, and only after the customer’s explicit yes call again with consent true, that consentTextVersion and a commandKey (a missing or stale version is refused). Never sees sportsbook passwords; never places a wager.
name: connect_sportsbook
title: Connect a sportsbook
